unreachable: Could not reach the API. Check that the backend is running.
sessionExpired: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.

ai.failed: The AI could not complete this request. Try again.
ai.rate_limited: The AI provider is handling too many requests right now. Wait a minute and try again.
ai.context_too_long: That is more text than the AI can take at once. Select a shorter passage.
ai.content_filtered: The AI provider declined to respond to this content.
ai.upstream_unavailable: The AI provider is not responding. Try again in a few minutes.
ai.invalid_key: AI is not set up on this server: its API key is missing or was rejected. Ask whoever runs it to check GEMINI_API_KEY.
ai.selection_invalid: Select the text you want rewritten first.
ai.daily_limit: This workspace has used up today's AI budget. It resets at midnight UTC.
ai.concurrency_limit: This workspace already has as many AI responses in progress as it is allowed. Wait for one to finish.
ai.timeout: The response took too long and was stopped.
ai.interrupted: The server restarted while writing this response. Try again.
ai.query_not_found: That AI response no longer exists.
ai.query_not_completed: Only a finished response can be inserted.
ai.stream_lost: Lost the connection to the response. Check your network and try again.

auth.email_undeliverable: That email domain does not exist or cannot receive mail. Check the address for typos.
auth.email_unverified: Confirm your email address before signing in.
auth.invalid_credentials: That email address and password do not match.
auth.invalid_token: Your session is not valid. Please sign in again.
auth.refresh_expired: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
auth.refresh_revoked: This session was ended for security. Sign in again.
auth.refresh_unknown: Your session is not valid. Please sign in again.
auth.reset_code_invalid: That code is wrong or has expired. Check it and try again, or request a new one.
auth.reset_locked: Too many wrong codes. Password recovery for this address is paused for a few minutes.
auth.token_expired: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
auth.verification_invalid: That code is wrong or has expired. Check it and try again, or request a new one.
auth.wrong_token_type: Your session is not valid. Please sign in again.

document.not_found: That document does not exist, or you cannot open it.
document.stale: This document changed while you were working on it.

member.absent: They are not a member of this workspace.
member.duplicate: They are already a member of this workspace.
member.is_owner: The owner cannot be removed from their own workspace.
member.unknown_email: No account uses that email address.
member.unverified: That person has not confirmed their email address yet.

rate_limit.exceeded: Too many attempts. Wait a little and try again.

request.invalid: Some of what you entered was not accepted. Check the fields and try again.
request.too_large: That is too large to send.

workspace.not_found: That workspace does not exist, or you are not a member of it.
